entry.title: Start a new advisor application
paragraphs: Open Advisor Login and choose New App. Enter the advisor email, advisor phone number and advisor code to start a new application.

eligibility.title: Complete Eligibility
paragraphs: Enter the applicant’s eligibility information. John Doe is the applicant in these captures; use the applicant email shown above for his application.

coverage.title: Select coverage
paragraphs: Select the coverage the applicant wants, including the applicable people, amounts and product options.

contact.title: Complete Contact
paragraphs: Enter the applicant’s contact information carefully. The existing-flow reference places the start of autosave after Contact.

profile.title: Complete Profile
paragraphs: Enter the required personal and financial details before moving to Review.

review-advisor.title: Review the prepared application
paragraphs: Check the application details through Review before confirming that it should be sent to the applicant.

send.title: Send the application
paragraphs: Confirm sending the prepared application to John Doe’s applicant email for completion and signature.

invitation.title: Open the application invitation
paragraphs: The applicant opens the email asking them to complete and sign the application. Its initial link starts the access process; it is separate from the requested MFA secure link.

applicant-email.title: Enter the applicant email
paragraphs: Open the link in the application email to reach Resume Application. Enter John Doe’s applicant email shown above to request a secure link.

applicant-secure-link.title: Open the requested secure link
paragraphs: Open the new secure-link email to continue verification. The reference email states that access to application information requires verification.

applicant-method.title: Choose Text or Call
paragraphs: Choose a delivery method for the verification code. The current-flow reference uses the applicant phone number provided in the application.

applicant-code.title: Verify the phone code
paragraphs: Enter the code delivered by the selected method to complete MFA and gain access to the application.

review-applicant.title: Review or request a correction
paragraphs: After MFA, review the application. Continue to complete it, or choose Request Edit if the advisor needs to correct the prepared information.

health.title: Complete remaining questions
paragraphs: Complete the remaining application sections, including applicable health questions.
health.placeholder: Current-template capture needed: Complete remaining questions.

signature.title: Sign the completed application
paragraphs: Sign the completed application through DocuSign. The current-flow reference places the spouse signature after the member signature when spouse coverage applies.
signature.placeholder: Current-template captures still needed: spouse signing and the signature-completion confirmation.

receipt.title: Review the receipt
paragraphs: Review the confirmation receipt and confirmation email after completing the application. The advisor also receives a completion notification.
receipt.placeholder: Current-template capture needed: Review the receipt.

edit-request.title: Request an advisor edit
paragraphs: In Review Application, choose Request Edit. Confirm Request sends the application back for the advisor to make the correction; Cancel keeps the applicant in review.

edit-email.title: Advisor receives the edit request
paragraphs: The advisor receives this email about John Doe’s edit request. The message identifies the applicant, confirmation reference and action REVISE. Use Saved App with the applicant email, then authenticate as the advisor.

saved-entry.title: Locate the saved application
paragraphs: Choose Saved App on Advisor Login and enter John Doe’s applicant email to locate the application. The following authentication steps use the advisor’s own email and phone.

advisor-email.title: Request an advisor secure link
paragraphs: Enter the advisor email shown above to receive the advisor’s secure link. The applicant email used for the Saved App lookup does not replace the advisor’s authentication email.
advisor-email.placeholder: Current-template capture needed: Request an advisor secure link.

advisor-secure-link.title: Open the advisor secure link
paragraphs: Open the secure-link email delivered to the advisor mailbox shown above, then continue verification using the advisor phone number.

advisor-method.title: Choose advisor code delivery
paragraphs: Choose Text or Call. The current-flow reference sends the code to the advisor phone number.
advisor-method.placeholder: Current-template capture needed: Choose advisor code delivery.

advisor-code.title: Verify the advisor phone code
paragraphs: Enter the code to finish verification and reopen the saved application.
advisor-code.placeholder: Current-template capture needed: Verify the advisor phone code.

revise.title: Revise and resend
paragraphs: Make the agreed changes, review the application, and send it back to the applicant. The applicant repeats secure access to review the updated application.
revise.placeholder: Current-template capture needed: Revise and resend.

edit-confirmation.title: Edit request sent confirmation
paragraphs: After confirming the request, the applicant sees the edit-request confirmation. The advisor is notified and must verify access before reopening the application.

sent-confirmation.title: Application sent confirmation
paragraphs: After confirming Send, check the confirmation that the application was sent to the applicant.

applicant-link-confirmation.title: Secure link sent confirmation
paragraphs: The portal confirms that a secure link was sent to the applicant email. Open the requested email to continue verification.

advisor-link-confirmation.title: Advisor secure link sent confirmation
paragraphs: The portal confirms that a secure link was sent to the advisor email. Open that email before proceeding to phone verification.
advisor-link-confirmation.placeholder: Current-template capture needed: Advisor secure link sent confirmation.

advisor-access.title: Reopen the verified saved application
paragraphs: After completing MFA, the advisor regains access to the saved application and can review its existing answers.
advisor-access.placeholder: Current-template capture needed: Reopen the verified saved application.

return-invitation.title: Return through the application email
paragraphs: Use the application link to return to a saved application or an application returned after an advisor update. This is the initial access link, not the requested MFA link.

resume-secure-link.title: Open the requested resume link
paragraphs: After requesting secure access, open the new resume-link email and continue phone verification.

sent-email.title: Advisor receives the application email
paragraphs: The advisor receives the application email after sending. The supplied capture is addressed to the advisor mailbox shown above; John Doe is the applicant named in the message.

sent.whenNotified: Immediately after the advisor confirms sending the application.

pending.whenNotified: According to the pending-signature email schedule while the application is incomplete.

deleted.whenNotified: When an incomplete saved application expires and is deleted.

completed.whenNotified: When the applicant completes and submits the application.

edit-requested.whenNotified: Immediately after the applicant confirms the edit request.
